connections.why: Choosing a method is the first step in planning a study
Design decisions determine which analyses are possible
Results are written up in the report's analysis sections
Students apply planning skills in their own practicals
Sound methods are central to psychology as a science
Core studies are understood through the methods that produced them
Interpreting study findings requires data-analysis skills
Each area feeds the perspectives and debates section
Cognitive studies inform debates such as reductionism
Biological studies drive the nature-nurture debate
Developmental studies underpin applied child psychology
Understanding disorders links to issues in mental health
Arousal in sport draws on biological psychology
Social influences help explain criminal behaviour
Psychology-as-a-science is itself a key debate
Applied topics are evaluated using research methods
